en: Hi, my name's Preston Holmes, and I'd like to introduce you to Scion. It's an open-source test bed for kind of exploring this new realm of agent orchestration where we give the agents an extra degree of autonomy. Um, and it's really around making more progress towards this progression from a beginning point where you have really no no AI in your world to increasingly amounts of uh sort of AI in your IDE, maybe switching to another terminal type um maybe later made popular by Cloud Code,

multiple agents to work together, and it's really could be as simple as sort of describing the way they work. pretty much anything that can uh interface with a a very sort of um simple uh set of abstractions around

hooks, around inputs and outputs. You take all those things, you give it a task, you run it in a container.
